caption: One common verification mistake is showing equipment without clearly establishing where the business operates. Even when a service-area business hides its address from customers, Google still needs evidence that connects the business to its real base. Start with a street sign, landmark, or building number, then move to the workspace, vehicle, equipment, and management proof. See the full one-take route: https://brightboxdigital.io/blog/google-business-profile-video-verification/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp_blog&utm_content=google-business-profile-video-verification-followup
